dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward a sharply defined posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white to light-grey; the left lateral side exhibits a lower-intensity value shift due to deep blue-tinted shadowing and water depth.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple low-contrast, fine linear striations and superficial scratch patterns visible on the central and right dorsal surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of superficial linear marks or faint rake-like scoring on the dorsal mid-section.
